metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-v2[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Fix ACE TUI freezes and prompt-input lag[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The ACE TUI stays responsive while typing in the prompt input and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]while navigating the Agents tab: the main thread stops burning CPU [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on redundant render and measurement passes, the one-second [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]countdown tick stops doing unbounded synchronous work on the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Textual pump, keystroke paths stop doing per-project disk I/O, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]background workers stop starving the event loop. Key-to-paint p95 [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on the Agents tab returns under the 16 ms budget and the stall [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]watchdog stops recording multi-second hitches during ordinary use.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]tui_freeze_regression.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-v2[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-v2/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop the prompt panel double-render and cache its section [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]anchors[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]section_visual[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]section_visual: memoize prompt-panel section anchors per (generation, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]width) and stop SectionTrackingVisual.get_height from running a second [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]full Rich console render on every measurement pass.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gate the countdown tick on prompt typing, not just j/k[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]countdown_gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]countdown_gate: extend the activity gate so the one-second countdown [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tick defers its Agents-tab repaint work while the user is typing in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt input, matching the documented tui_perf activity-gate rule.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop per-tick config-token thread churn and per-key token [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]lookups[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]config_token[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]config_token: move the refresh-thread spawn out of the config-token [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cache lock, raise the revalidation interval above the tick cadence, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolve tribe displays once per call instead of once per panel key.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Take per-project disk I/O off the prompt completion keystroke [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]path[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]prompt_completion[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt_completion: cache project workflow-type and changespec-name [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lookups across calls and keep the debounced soft-completion timer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]callback free of synchronous per-project file reads.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Index artifact link targets instead of scanning them per ref[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]artifact_index[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact_index: replace the linear known-target scan in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]_known_target_for_ref with a prebuilt index so patch loading stops [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]burning worker CPU and stealing the GIL from the event loop.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Regression guards for the repaired hot paths[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]perf_guards[dim] · [dim][/dim]after section_visual, countdown_gate, config_token, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]prompt_completion, artifact_index[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]perf_guards: add benches and unit guards that fail if the prompt panel [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]double-renders, the countdown tick ignores typing, the config token [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]spawns a thread per tick, the completion path reads project files, or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the artifact link lookup returns to a linear scan.[/#D7D7AF]
